blocks.en: ReLEAF’s hardware centers on a closed-loop hollow-fiber bioreactor designed to bring protectant production closer to the farm, reducing the transport, storage, and repeated purchasing associated with externally manufactured products. To make on-site production practical, the system combines a 0.2 µm hollow-fiber module with circulation pumps, pressure and flow monitoring, in-line OD600 measurement, and controlled recovery from the shell side. Across three integrated runs, the bioreactor supported continuous culture, real-time monitoring, extracellular ACC deaminase recovery, and whole-cell retention, with no colonies observed from plated shell-side samples under the tested conditions. We also developed an assembly guide and user manual to make the hardware easier to reproduce and adapt for future on-site biomanufacturing systems.

2.1 從 TgPGPR 到一部生物反應器

blocks.en: Climate change makes crop stress more frequent and harder to predict, and we want to give crops a genetically modified bioprotectant to help them cope. Our first design was a transgenic plant‑growth‑promoting rhizobacterium (TgPGPR) that would live on the roots and make the protectant there.
blocks.text: Climate change makes crop stress more frequent and harder to predict, and we want to give crops a genetically modified bioprotectant to help them cope. Our first design was a transgenic plant‑growth‑promoting rhizobacterium (TgPGPR) that would live on the roots and make the protectant there.
blocks.zh: 氣候變遷讓作物逆境更頻繁、也更難預測，我們想給作物一種基因改造的生物保護劑，幫牠們應付。我們最初的設計是一株轉基因的植物生長促進根圈細菌（TgPGPR），讓牠住在根上、就地製造保護劑。

blocks.en: We chose a bioreactor instead, for two reasons. The main one is biosafety. Once a transgenic organism is released, its expression, dose and spread can no longer be controlled. The other is survival. Lab strains of Bacillus subtilis lack motility, can’t form biofilm and have metabolic deficiencies, so they would struggle in the field anyway.

blocks.en: We only need the protectant in the field, so we keep the organism in a machine and send out only its product. That turns a release problem into a containment problem.

blocks.zh: 2.2 為何選用 Bacillus subtilis 與灌流式中空纖維

blocks.en: We chose Bacillus subtilis because the FDA classifies nonpathogenic, nontoxigenic strains as Generally Recognized as Safe (GRAS) under good manufacturing practices. It is easy to engineer, and it secretes recombinant protein into the medium, so the cells never have to be broken open to collect the protectant.
blocks.text: We chose Bacillus subtilis because the FDA classifies nonpathogenic, nontoxigenic strains as Generally Recognized as Safe (GRAS) under good manufacturing practices. It is easy to engineer, and it secretes recombinant protein into the medium, so the cells never have to be broken open to collect the protectant.
blocks.zh: 我們選用 Bacillus subtilis，因為 FDA 把非病原、非產毒的菌株在良好製造規範下列為一般認為安全（GRAS）。它容易進行工程改造，而且會把重組蛋白質分泌到培養基中，因此不必破開細胞就能收取保護劑。

blocks.en: We used two strains. B. subtilis 168 ran the growth tests and the first integrated run, where it barely made detectable enzyme, probably because its own secreted proteases broke the product down. Every later run used B. subtilis WB800, which lacks those proteases (4.2, prototype 1). Both are nonpathogenic lab strains, and the hardware is the same for either.

blocks.en: The transmembrane pressure (TMP) is the mean lumen pressure minus the shell pressure: TMP = (Pfeed + Pretentate) / 2 − Ppermeate. To tie pressure to flow, the pump stepped from 10% to 100% output in 10% steps, one minute at each.

Here the membrane track and the long‑term run meet. Prototype 1 is the first integrated run, 116 hours with Bacillus subtilis 168. Prototype 2 (WB800) adds the pinch valve, the pH probe and one mainboard, and finds ACC deaminase on the shell side at the lumen’s level. blocks.text: Here the membrane track and the long‑term run meet. Prototype 1 is the first integrated run, 116 hours with Bacillus subtilis 168. Prototype 2 (WB800) adds the pinch valve, the pH probe and one mainboard, and finds ACC deaminase on the shell side at the lumen’s level. Prototype 3 maintains the pH with KOH and sterilizes the loop in place. Prototype 4, the final version, automates the pH control and the shell sampling and follows active ACC deaminase on the shell side for 72 hours. In the first three, ACC deaminase is under a constitutive promoter, so light control is out of the test and the loop itself is what is examined. What the reviewers changed between runs is in part 6.
blocks.zh: 在這裡，薄膜軌線與長時間運轉交會。原型 1 是第一次整合運轉，以 Bacillus subtilis 168 跑了 116 小時。原型 2（WB800）加上夾管閥、pH 探針與一塊主板，並在殼側測到與管腔相當濃度的 ACC 去胺酶。原型 3 以 KOH 維持 pH，並在原位對迴路滅菌。原型 4 是最終版本，把 pH 控制與殼側取樣自動化，並追蹤殼側具活性的 ACC 去胺酶達 72 小時。前三個原型中，ACC 去胺酶由組成型啟動子驅動，因此光控制不在測試之內，被檢驗的是迴路本身。審閱者在各次運轉之間改了什麼，寫在第 6 部分。

blocks.en: A second growth after the plateau is not what a batch curve does. Our working explanation is that the erythromycin degraded, the cells began to lose the plasmid, and with less metabolic burden they grew again. Plasmid stability was what Prof. Chang asked about in September (6.1). Strain 168 also barely made detectable ACC deaminase, probably because its secreted proteases degrade the product, so the next prototype uses B. subtilis WB800, which lacks them. The unstable pressure readings still need explaining; the electronics review that followed is in 6.2.

The DNPH assay measures enzyme activity by detecting the α‑ketobutyrate made when ACC deaminase breaks down ACC. It was adopted on Prof. Chang’s advice to show the protectant is being made (6.1). The ELISA measures how much protein is there. The pressure transducers read stably this time.

That is consistent with the protectants crossing the membrane at close to the culture’s concentration.

blocks.en: The ELISA also followed ACC deaminase through the run (the time course below). Both sides peaked near 16 h, at 7.5 µg/mL in the lumen and 7.2 on the shell side, then fell together, staying within about 0.8 µg/mL of each other. blocks.zh: 原型 2 讓培養基過酸。pH 6.5 或更低會嚴重傷害 B. subtilis 的生長與細胞分裂，也傷害保護劑酵素的穩定性，因此我們把 pH 探針保留在管腔側，並在 pH 下降時加入 KOH。

blocks.en: We also worked out how to sterilize the assembled loop without an autoclave, by chemical clean‑in‑place (CIP). We pump in 900 mL of distilled water, then 100 mL of 35% hydrogen peroxide; they mix in the lumen reservoir and circulate for 15 minutes, and a starch–iodide test paper checks for peroxide. The solution drains through a tube, which is reattached to close the loop. Then 1 L of distilled water circulates for 30 minutes, with a fresh test paper after each wash, until no peroxide is left. It usually takes five 1 L washes.

blocks.zh: 我們也想出了不用高壓滅菌鍋就能對組裝好的迴路滅菌的方法，也就是化學原位清洗（CIP）。我們先打入 900 mL 蒸餾水，再打入 100 mL 35% 過氧化氫；兩者在管腔儲槽中混合並循環 15 分鐘，再以澱粉-碘化鉀試紙檢查過氧化氫。溶液經一根管子排出，之後再接回以封閉迴路。接著 1 L 蒸餾水循環 30 分鐘，每次清洗後換一張新試紙，直到沒有過氧化氫殘留。通常需要五次 1 L 清洗。

The notebook adds that permeate was halved to 12 mL/min and the photometer’s acceptance gate was running (notebook, week 33).

blocks.en: The run started on October 14, 2026. Since prototype 2 had shown both sides read the same (its Learn), protectant was drawn from the shell side only, twice, at hours 1.10 and 18.38. At the 38‑hour mark, unnoticed at the time, a Luer valve at the start of the lumen loop broke in half and medium leaked into the incubator. Up to then the pH and OD curves were reliable: clear readings of growth, and of how the pH responded to growth and to KOH. The OD rose from 0.14 to 2.71 by 37 h, a fitted growth rate of 0.286 h−1 (notebook, week 33). That is inside the range forecast before the run. On October 1 a growth rate of 0.2986 h−1 was registered, passing if the fitted rate fell between 0.2705 and 0.3300 h−1 (notebook, week 31). After 38 hours the pump’s shaking had knocked the photometer’s light path out of line, so later OD data cannot be used.

blocks.en: Prototype 3 called for the pH to be corrected automatically (its Learn), so this cycle automates both the pH control and the shell‑side sampling. blocks.en: Two things changed in the bioreactor. The first is the pair of servo‑driven valves, the pinch valve and the Luer valve controller. They let us sample the shell permeate and record the pressure change at the same time, and the pressure transducer readings show whether the pinch valve drives the product from the lumen medium into the shell permeate.

blocks.en: The second is automatic pH adjustment. A peristaltic pump, with a maximum flow of about 60 mL/min, sits before the feeding valve, so it can pump in base and external feeds such as TB medium or antibiotics. blocks.en: The pressure record during a shell sample shows how the valves move product into the shell permeate (the chart below). In normal operation the main peristaltic pump makes the transmembrane pressure (TMP) pulse, and its lowest transient values are negative (panel B). For those moments fluid is drawn back from the shell side into the lumen before it is pushed out again, and this two‑way exchange keeps the shell space from becoming a dead volume.

blocks.zh: 殼側取樣期間的壓力記錄顯示閥如何把產物移進殼側透過液（見下圖）。正常運轉時，主蠕動幫浦讓跨膜壓差（TMP）脈動，其瞬時最低值為負（圖版 B）。在那些時刻，液體會先從殼側被抽回管腔，再被推出去，而這種雙向交換使殼側空間不致變成死體積。

blocks.en: Opening the shell‑side valve vents the shell space to the atmosphere, and the permeate pressure drops to near 0 bar. Closing the pinch valve then raises the TMP, from about 0.03 to 0.16 bar on average, and speeds up the filtration of the product. One minute with the pinch valve closed gave about 20 to 30 mL of shell permeate.

blocks.en: The shell permeate was sampled at 1, 6, 12, 18, 24, 30, 36, 48 and 72 h and frozen at −20 °C until the assays. blocks.en: The DNPH assay shows the enzyme active from 18 h (panel B): 0.037 mU/mL at 18 h, then between 0.013 and 0.023 mU/mL to 72 h, against about 0.003 at 6 and 12 h and none at 1 h. One unit (U) of ACC deaminase activity is the amount of enzyme that releases 1 µmol of α‑ketobutyrate per hour under the assay conditions (30 °C, 12 h incubation). The specific activity, the volumetric activity divided by the ELISA concentration (panel C), stays below 1 U/mg before 18 h and lies between 2.3 and 8.3 U/mg from then on, so the functional enzyme appears at 18 h.

blocks.en: Against DBTL 2 (5.1), this run follows the shell side nearly twice as long, through 72 h instead of 40 h, at a similar level: the ELISA peak of 6.5 µg/mL at 12 h compares with 7.2 µg/mL near 16 h then (time course), and the activity is now given in units. The enzyme may be inactive at first because ACC deaminase must work as a multimer and needs the coenzyme pyridoxal 5′‑phosphate, and the extracellular environment may not favor its folding and maturation. Even so, the shell permeate from our bioreactor has ACC deaminase activity, which shows that the system can produce and recover a functional recombinant enzyme.

blocks.zh: 與 DBTL 2（5.1）相比，這次運轉追蹤殼側的時間幾乎加倍，從 40 h 延長到 72 h，濃度則相當：12 h 的 ELISA 高峰 6.5 µg/mL，對應當時接近 16 h 的 7.2 µg/mL（時間序列），而活性現在以單位表示。酵素一開始可能沒有活性，因為 ACC 去胺酶必須以多聚體形式作用，並需要輔酶磷酸吡哆醛（pyridoxal 5′‑phosphate），而胞外環境可能不利於它的折疊與成熟。即使如此，我們生物反應器的殼側透過液具有 ACC 去胺酶活性，這顯示系統能生產並回收具功能的重組酵素。

blocks.zh: 中空纖維生物反應器可行嗎？放大時會壞在哪裡？這次會談在生物反應器組裝之前舉行，為整合原型 1 與 2 的建造定下了議題。來源：筆記，第 16 週；團隊人類實踐頁。

blocks.en: Transmembrane pressureThe largest gap he found was that nothing in the design pushed the protectant from the lumen side, where it is made, to the shell side, where it leaves. A higher flow rate would only recirculate the fluid, not build outward pressure. He recommended a valve after the membrane to build pressure, and narrower tubing to concentrate it.

A higher flow rate would only recirculate the fluid, not build outward pressure. He recommended a valve after the membrane to build pressure, and narrower tubing to concentrate it.
blocks.zh: 跨膜壓差他找到最大的缺口是：設計中沒有任何東西把保護劑從製造它的管腔側，推到它離開的殼側。提高流量只會讓流體再循環，不會建立向外的壓力。他建議在薄膜之後加一個閥來建立壓力，並用較細的管路把壓力集中。

blocks.en: MembraneOur membrane might be too big, which raises the risk of cells sticking to or clogging the fibers, so he recommended a smaller one. Flow rate and transmembrane pressure must be monitored, since they show fouling (caking). And we should be ready to tell judges why we chose hollow fiber, which we could not yet answer.

blocks.zh: 薄膜我們的薄膜可能太大，這會提高細胞附著或堵塞纖維的風險，因此他建議換小一點的。流量與跨膜壓差必須監測，因為它們顯示結垢（結餅）。另外，我們應該準備好向評審說明為何選擇中空纖維，而當時我們還答不出來。

blocks.en: ChangedA pinch valve, first designed the next day around a stepper motor and switched to a servo in August (notebook, week 23), maintains a transmembrane pressure that pushes product to the shell side (4.2, prototype 2). Three pressure transducers and a flowmeter on the lumen side read fouling; they gave the ΔP–Q relationship and the operating point (4.1, prototypes 1–3) and the readings in prototype 2’s Test. A smaller membrane: the first growth runs used one 30 cm long in a 6.3 cm housing, about 1.3 m²; the integrated runs use a 60 cm module in a 1 cm housing, 200 cm² (10.1), with the same 0.2 µm, 1 mm fibers, fitted in August (notebook, week 24). And the case for hollow fiber (2.2).

blocks.en: Growth at 22 °CGrowth of Bacillus subtilis at 22 °C had been inconsistent, in the first test and again with the engineered strain (photometer page, 2). He suggested contamination or a trait of the strain, asked whether we had tested plasmid stability, and advised repeating the experiment. This kind of inconsistency is common but hard to explain from one run, and a repeat that behaves is enough to move on.

He suggested contamination or a trait of the strain, asked whether we had tested plasmid stability, and advised repeating the experiment. blocks.zh: 22 °C 的生長Bacillus subtilis 在 22 °C 的生長一直不一致，第一次測試如此，換成工程化菌株後也是（光度計頁，2）。他認為可能是汙染，或是該菌株的某個特性，並問我們是否測過質體穩定性，建議重做這個實驗。這類不一致很常見，但從單一次運轉很難解釋，而只要重做一次表現正常就足以往下走。

blocks.en: Proving productionJudges will ask how we confirm the protectant is released. B. subtilis cannot bear a fluorescent marker for this, and true quantification may cost too much, so we discussed a DNPH assay, along with hydroponic testing and color indicators a farmer could read by eye.

blocks.en: Farmer useHe saw the updated rig and pressed for usability and AIoT integration. A deployed bioreactor should be modular and easy to handle, ideally with the B. subtilis in a replaceable capsule swapped like a battery, with no hands‑on technical control. He also advised plainer wording for farmers and tying the project to the SDGs.

blocks.en: ChangedWe adopted the DNPH assay (enzyme activity) and ran it with the ELISA (amount of protein) on both sides to confirm the protectant is released (4.2, prototype 2). The 22 °C pattern did not recur in the next run; the plateau and the regrowth after it, put down to plasmid loss, are in 4.2, prototype 1. The capsule is future work, as the planned sealed refill cartridges (9.2.5).

blocks.zh: 對為整合原型 1 所造的生物反應器，檢討它的伺服控制、電源供應與控制板佈局。它找到的每一項缺陷都在原型 2 運轉前修正。來源：團隊人類實踐頁。

blocks.en: Servo controlWe had planned a PCA9685 driver board for the servos that turn the Luer valve and the pinch valve. In his experience it is unreliable. Told to turn 90°, it may stop at 85°, and a valve that misses its position can cause a sudden pressure spike that breaks the tubing and leaks. The servos also lacked the torque to turn the valves. He suggested the STS3215 servo, driven over UART, which is accurate and strong enough.
blocks.text: Servo controlWe had planned a PCA9685 driver board for the servos that turn the Luer valve and the pinch valve. In his experience it is unreliable. Told to turn 90°, it may stop at 85°, and a valve that misses its position can cause a sudden pressure spike that breaks the tubing and leaks. The servos also lacked the torque to turn the valves. He suggested the STS3215 servo, driven over UART, which is accurate and strong enough.
blocks.zh: 伺服控制我們原本計畫用 PCA9685 驅動板來帶動轉動 Luer 閥與夾管閥的伺服。依他的經驗，它不可靠。叫它轉 90°，它可能停在 85°，而沒有到位的閥可能造成突然的壓力尖峰，把管路弄破而漏液。那些伺服也沒有足夠的扭力轉動閥。他建議改用以 UART 驅動的 STS3215 伺服，既精確、力量也夠。

blocks.en: Power supplyThe plan powered everything through an AMS1117 module, 12 V down to 5 V for most sensors and 3.3 V for the UNO Q. With valve and pump control added, they need more current than it can give.
blocks.text: Power supplyThe plan powered everything through an AMS1117 module, 12 V down to 5 V for most sensors and 3.3 V for the UNO Q. With valve and pump control added, they need more current than it can give.
blocks.zh: 電源供應原本的設計以一個 AMS1117 模組供應所有東西，從 12 V 降到 5 V 給大多數感測器、3.3 V 給 UNO Q。加上閥與幫浦控制後，它們需要的電流超過它能給的。

blocks.en: Control boardThe Arduino UNO Q uses 3.3 V logic, not the usual 5 V, so the pumps, motors and sensors need their voltage stepped. After reading the code, he confirmed the UNO Q has to stay the main board and suggested two boards in series: the UNO Q reads the sensors and serves the interface, and an Arduino Mega 2560 drives the pumps and valves. That keeps high‑current parts off the main controller and voltage‑sensitive sensors, such as the pressure transmitters, away from the pump and valve current.

blocks.zh: 控制板Arduino UNO Q 用 3.3 V 邏輯，而不是常見的 5 V，因此幫浦、馬達與感測器的電壓都需要轉換。讀過程式碼後，他確認 UNO Q 必須留作主板，並建議兩塊板串接：UNO Q 讀感測器並提供介面，Arduino Mega 2560 驅動幫浦與閥。這樣能讓大電流的部件遠離主控制器，也讓對電壓敏感的感測器，例如壓力傳送器，遠離幫浦與閥的電流。

Two days later the mainboard, built for the same isolation, replaced the two‑board plan (next entry).

blocks.en: MainboardTwo boards would have meant a bulky package with wires everywhere. Instead, one mainboard contains everything: a converter from 12 V to 5 V and 3.3 V, and every UNO Q pin brought onto it, so the board in effect becomes the UNO Q. A jumper wire sets each pin to any of the three voltages, so any pin can be used for anything and the old tangle becomes swappable modules.

blocks.zh: 主板兩塊板會造成一個龐大的組件，到處都是線。取而代之的是一塊主板，裡面什麼都有：一個從 12 V 轉 5 V 與 3.3 V 的轉換器，以及把 UNO Q 每一支腳位都引到板上，使這塊板實際上就成了 UNO Q。一根跳線就能把每支腳位設到三種電壓中的任一種，因此任何腳位都能做任何用途，原本那團線也變成可替換的模組。

blocks.en: ChangedWe dropped the two‑board design and built the mainboard (4.2, prototype 2). It supplies the current the AMS1117 could not, and it keeps the 3.3 V UNO Q apart from the pumps and valves, the aim of the two‑board plan. With the transducers moved to 12 V and their ground on the DC–DC module, it also ended prototype 1’s unstable pressure readings, a problem we had not asked about. By prototype 2’s Test the transducers read stably. And it made the sensors modular, so the pH probe and the pinch‑valve servo went in without rewiring, with power delivery and electrical isolation reworked (notebook, week 30; 7.1.3).

blocks.en: A leak outside the membrane. The planned droplet sensor under the loop is meant to catch leaks like this (9.2.3).

blocks.en: The lab bioreactor already reads pressure at three membrane ports (feed, retentate and permeate) and shows the transmembrane pressure (TMP) on the dashboard (4.2); the commercial design reads all four (In‑Lumen, Out‑Lumen, In‑Shell, Out‑Shell). Today these numbers are only displayed. We will program the controller to act on them: when the lumen pressure or the TMP passes a set threshold, it sounds an alarm, stops the culture pump and opens the pinch valve.

Today these numbers are only displayed. We will program the controller to act on them: when the lumen pressure or the TMP passes a set threshold, it sounds an alarm, stops the culture pump and opens the pinch valve.
blocks.zh: 實驗室生物反應器已經在薄膜三個接口（進料、濃縮液與透過液）讀壓力，並在儀表板上顯示跨膜壓差（TMP）（4.2）；商用設計則讀四個（In‑Lumen、Out‑Lumen、In‑Shell、Out‑Shell）。目前這些數字只是顯示出來。我們會把控制器寫成依它們行動：當管腔壓力或 TMP 超過設定門檻，就發出警報、停止培養幫浦，並打開夾管閥。

blocks.en: Too much pressure is the condition most likely to force cells through a damaged fiber or burst a fitting, so this layer acts before a breach happens. A sudden drop can mean the membrane has already given way, often before any liquid shows, so the run stops and a shell‑side sample is plated to check (8).

blocks.en: The first layer watches fluid where it should be; the second watches where it should not. A droplet sensor under the setup will detect liquid escaping from the tubing or connections, then sound an alarm and stop the pumps, so a slow leak from a loose fitting cannot run on unnoticed.

blocks.en: Over a season a farmer has to top up both the medium and the culture, and neither is safe to do by hand. So the commercial bioreactor takes two sealed, single‑use cartridges: ready‑to‑use sterile medium, and a B. subtilis spore stock that ships at room temperature. Both drop into one keyed dock: the medium cartridge has a D‑shaped collar and the spore cartridge a round one, so neither fits the other’s port.
blocks.text: Over a season a farmer has to top up both the medium and the culture, and neither is safe to do by hand. So the commercial bioreactor takes two sealed, single‑use cartridges: ready‑to‑use sterile medium, and a B. subtilis spore stock that ships at room temperature. Both drop into one keyed dock: the medium cartridge has a D‑shaped collar and the spore cartridge a round one, so neither fits the other’s port.
blocks.zh: 在一季之中，農友必須補充培養基與培養液，而兩者都不適合用手來做。因此商用生物反應器採用兩個密封的單次使用匣：即用型無菌培養基，以及一份 B. subtilis 孢子原液，它可以室溫運送。兩者都插進同一個帶鎖定形狀的插座：培養基匣的套環是 D 形，孢子匣是圓形，因此兩者都插不進對方的接口。

Medium goes in first, then the spores. The cartridges are the only part a farmer handles; spent ones come back to us sealed.

blocks.en: The next steps toward a prototype are a reliable seal (the printed parts were not watertight, so it needs molded parts or O‑ring glands), sterility over repeated changeovers, and confirmation that the strain sporulates and germinates reliably from stored spores.

attrs.en: OD600 over 116 hours: a gap with no data from about 3 to 13 hours, a rise to about 1.7 by 40 hours, a short dip, then a second rise from about 48 hours to about 3.8 at the end

attrs.en: Three stacked plots over about 38 hours: OD600 rises slowly to about 0.3 by 9 hours, falls, then jumps and oscillates between 1 and 1.5 for the rest of the run; pH falls from 6.55 to 6.24 over the first 8 hours, swings between 6.2 and 6.9 from 13 to 19 hours, then sits flat at 6.9; flow holds near 390 mL/min, then near 320 mL/min after 11 hours, with brief drops to zero

attrs.en: Three dark dashboard plots over 42 hours from 14 October 10:56. OD600 climbs from near 0 to about 2.7 by 37 hours, then jumps to about 10. pH falls from 6.9 to 6.4 over 18 hours, steps up to about 7.1, eases, steps up again to about 7.2 at the 24-hour seam between two recordings, and ends near 7.05. attrs.en: Diagram of the fourth and final integrated bioreactor. The culture bottle with B. subtilis sits on a magnetic stirrer, with a pH probe and a filter in its cap. attrs.en: The controller board's component side. Top left, the power corner: a DC jack into the buck converter, a 3-digit voltmeter display, a toggle switch with a blue trimmer, and two 2-pin sockets for 12 V and ground. Female headers for the Arduino UNO Q run down both sides of the opening it sits under. Six 3-pin sensor ports, A0 to A5, run down the left edge; six, D13 to D8, down the right; eight, RX0, TX1 and D2 to D7, along the bottom; a 3-pin UART port for valve control sits bottom right; three I2C connectors for the photometer's light sensors sit top right. Each port is a 3-pin socket beside a two-row header in red, yellow and white for plus, signal and ground. Thin yellow wires join each Arduino pin to the port of the same name, thick yellow links join the ports' plus pins, and black jumper caps sit on some headers.
attrs.zh: 控制板的零件面。左上是電源區：一個 DC 插孔接入降壓轉換器、一個三位數電壓錶顯示器、一個撥動開關與一個藍色可變電阻，以及兩個供 12 V 與接地用的 2 針插座。Arduino UNO Q 的母排針沿著它所在開口的兩側排列。左緣有六個 3 針感測器接口 A0 到 A5；右緣有六個 D13 到 D8；底部有八個 RX0、TX1 與 D2 到 D7；右下角是一個供閥控制用的 3 針 UART 接口；右上角是三個供光度計光感測器用的 I2C 接頭。每個接口都是一個 3 針插座，旁邊是紅、黃、白三色的雙排排針，分別對應正極、訊號與接地。細黃線把每一支 Arduino 腳位接到同名的接口，粗黃線把各接口的正極腳位連起來，部分排針上插著黑色跳線帽。

attrs.en: The solder side, seen from below so left and right swap: the Arduino header pins, each digital and analog pin with a short yellow link into the board; two bare buses beside the digital header, one from its ground pin; tinned rails under the bottom row of ports; the ports' header pins bridged in pairs; an SS34 Schottky diode by the power corner with black, red and blue leads; a white wire round the edge; a 2 by 5 and a 2 by 3 female socket
attrs.zh: 焊接面，由下方看，因此左右相反：Arduino 排針腳位，每一支數位與類比腳位都有一小段黃線接入板內；數位排針旁有兩條裸露匯流排，其中一條來自它的接地腳；底部那排接口下方有鍍錫導軌；各接口的排針腳位兩兩橋接；電源區旁有一顆 SS34 蕭特基二極體，接著黑、紅、藍三色引線；一條白線沿板緣走；還有一個 2 乘 5 與一個 2 乘 3 的母座

attrs.en: The adapter board sealed in clear hot glue, seen from its component side: a white three-pin socket on the left marked 4 in blue, a three-pin male header on the right, both with their pins hand-marked minus, plus and S, and a round red capacitor over a blue resistor in the middle
attrs.zh: 轉接板封在透明熱熔膠中，自零件面看：左邊是一個白色三針插座，以藍色標示 4，右邊是一個三針公排針，兩者的腳位都手寫標示負、正與 S，中間是一顆圓形紅色電容壓在一個藍色電阻上

attrs.en: The adapter's component side, drawn: a three by eight hole board, the socket's pins in column 2 and the header's in column 7, in rows minus, plus and S. The 15 kilo-ohm resistor lies in the S row and the 22 kilo-ohm in the plus row, between columns 3 and 6, under the 104 capacitor, whose two leads go into the minus row at columns 3 and 6
attrs.zh: 轉接板零件面的繪圖：一塊 3 乘 8 孔的板子，插座的腳位在第 2 列，排針的腳位在第 7 列，分屬負、正與 S 三行。15 kΩ 電阻位於 S 行，22 kΩ 位於正行，都在第 3 與第 6 列之間，上方是 104 電容，它的兩支引線接入負行的第 3 與第 6 列

attrs.en: The adapter's solder side, seen from below with the S row at the top: a red wire carries plus from column 2 to 7 and a black wire carries minus round the board edge; column 3 is soldered together from the socket’s S pin as the divided output, and column 6 of the plus and minus rows with the header’s minus pin as ground; a dashed line marks the link from the 15 kilo-ohm to the header’s S, which is not marked
attrs.zh: 轉接板焊接面，由下方看，S 行在上：一條紅線把正極從第 2 列帶到第 7 列，一條黑線沿板緣帶走負極；第 3 列與插座的 S 腳焊接在一起，作為分壓後的輸出，正行與負行的第 6 列則與排針的負極腳一起作為接地；虛線標示從 15 kΩ 到排針 S 的連接，該連接並未被標記

attrs.en: The adapter's circuit: plus and minus pass straight through; S comes in on the header and through 15 kilo-ohms to the socket’s S, with 22 kilo-ohms and a 0.1 microfarad capacitor from S out to ground, so 5 volts in gives about 2.97 volts out
attrs.zh: 轉接板的電路：正極與負極直接通過；S 由排針進入，經 15 kΩ 到插座的 S，並有 22 kΩ 與一顆 0.1 µF 電容從輸出端的 S 接到地，因此輸入 5 V 可得到約 2.97 V 的輸出
